mainProcedure.title: Install a software update package

warning.warningAndCautionPara: Make sure that the radar system is in MAINTENANCE mode before you install the software package.

mainProcedure.title: Procedure

proceduralStep.para: Connect the maintenance laptop to the service port.
Connect the approved Ethernet service cable.

mainProcedure.codeblock: $ rpu-maint package verify RPU-4.3.1.pkg Signature: VALID Applicability: MATCH

note.notePara: Record the installed software version in the configuration record.
